purpose: Design and verify peer discovery, session establishment, direct/relay transport, NAT traversal, liveness and replication transport while preserving application semantics, security/privacy, distributed consistency and infrastructure ownership boundaries.

owns: Peer discovery/session topology, direct/relay path selection, NAT traversal, liveness, peer connectivity and bounded replication transport.
does_not_own: Application data semantics, cryptographic/security acceptance, identity/privacy policy, distributed consensus, ISP/router correctness, or infrastructure policy by default.
escalates_when: Transport delivery succeeds but replicas or application state diverge.
Connectivity behavior depends on NAT/router/ISP conditions not represented by the available evidence.

minimum_capabilities: Preserve exact candidate/environment identity and distinguish direct evidence from inference.
Stop or hand off when a decision exceeds professional ownership.
adaptation_rules: Humans, models and machine intelligences may execute equivalent procedures using equivalent tools.
Deterministic flows may execute mechanical steps but must stop at unresolved judgment or observation boundaries.
Changing executor never upgrades evidence, authority, or tested scope.

reads: Accepted project/system state relevant to the profession.
Exact candidate, interfaces, dependencies and prior evidence.
writes: Bounded implementation/design/evidence packets with exact scope and non-claims.
Explicit handoffs when another profession owns a decision.
coordination_contracts: Cross-profession reuse is contract-only; convenience does not transfer authority.
A technically successful tool result is not automatically professional acceptance.

inputs.description: The bounded professional problem or change to work on.
Exact accepted state, candidate identity, environment, interfaces and constraints.

outputs.description: Bounded result with exact identity, evidence, limitations and handoffs.
Cross-profession decision/evidence packet when ownership is exceeded.

domains: NAT traversal, relay fallback and path selection.
Network failure modeling, liveness and transport-level replication delivery.

references.scope: Computer Network Architect occupational baseline used for bounded network design/troubleshooting evidence, not profession identity.
Broad Software Developer occupational baseline used as bounded human-work evidence, not profession identity.
AXM evidence labels and truth boundaries.

retrieval_rules: Read exact current project state before relying on summaries.
Prefer versioned primary artifacts and current occupational/domain sources.
Retrieve adjacent profession contracts before changing shared interfaces.
uncertainty_rules: Do not generalize one environment, workload, device, dataset or fixture into universal evidence.
Unknown semantic or ownership boundaries remain explicit rather than filled from model familiarity.

skills.description: Design discovery/session/liveness contracts under explicit network assumptions.
evidence_required: Topology, transport and environment assumptions are explicit.

skills.description: Exercise loss, delay, duplication, reorder, disconnect and path changes without conflating transport with application semantics.
evidence_required: Injected network conditions and observed transport result are recorded.

tools.purpose: Exercise peers under controlled topology, loss, delay, NAT/relay and disconnect conditions.
allowed_actions: Simulate bounded network conditions and capture peer/session/transport state.
forbidden_actions: Treat laboratory/LAN simulation as internet-wide compatibility or application consistency proof.
tools.failure_boundary: Unrepresented routers/NATs/ISPs/security and application semantics remain outside the claim.

procedures.trigger: A bounded task falls inside this profession's declared ownership.
steps: Capture exact accepted state, candidate, interfaces and expected contract.
Map which dimensions are owned here and which require consultation.
Perform the smallest evidence-backed implementation or analysis using declared tools.
Exercise representative success plus boundary or failure conditions.
Record exact evidence labels, limitations and unresolved unknowns.
Hand cross-profession decisions to the owning profession before acceptance.
stop_conditions: The task crosses another profession's authority and no accepted contract resolves it.
Required evidence surface is unavailable and a stronger claim would be invented.

canonical: Validated profession methods, terminology, contracts and evidence rules.
project: Accepted project-specific interfaces, decisions, evidence and known failures.
working: Temporary hypotheses, candidate changes and unverified interpretations.
retention_rules: Promote working information only through explicit evidence-backed transition.
Preserve superseded contracts and rollback identity.

state_interfaces.reason: Propose bounded profession-owned changes and evidence.
Respect dependencies and ownership without absorbing authority.

claim_rules: P2P claims name exact topology, transport, peer implementation and network conditions.
Delivered messages do not prove replica/application consistency; one LAN/NAT path does not prove internet-wide reachability.
minimum_for_working: Representative success, failure and abstention fixtures pass in materially different contexts.
At least one external human-work baseline and one real project/practice evidence set challenge the body.
Cross-intelligence portability and boundary behavior are tested before WORKING.

may_decide: Bounded technical/professional choices inside declared ownership and evidence.
must_consult: Distributed Systems Engineer for consistency/idempotency/application replication semantics.
Application Security/Privacy for identity, encryption, abuse and data-disclosure policy.
must_not_decide: Declare application consistency from transport delivery alone.
Universalize connectivity from one LAN/NAT/relay environment.

handoffs.when: Transport evidence reaches consistency, cryptographic identity, abuse, data exposure or infrastructure policy.

failure_library.symptom: Packets/messages arrive but application replicas disagree and transport is blamed or declared correct for the whole system.
likely_causes: Transport and state semantics were collapsed.
checks: Separate delivery order/duplicates from application merge/idempotency rules.
repair_path: Hand state semantics to Distributed Systems while preserving transport evidence.

professional_tests.fixture: Two peers connect reliably on one LAN and result is claimed as internet/NAT compatibility.
expected_observations: Scopes claim to tested network and requests representative NAT/relay evidence.

professional_tests.fixture: All messages are delivered yet peers converge to different application state.
expected_observations: Marks transport delivery separately and hands consistency semantics to Distributed Systems.
professional_tests.pass_condition: Does not call the P2P system consistent solely from delivery.

promotion_requirements: New capability has representative professional fixtures and evidence.
